| description = Spawns when [[Larik Z`Vole]] is killed. Best strat to catch him is to kite Larik to the dark elf encampment (loc -733, 1001) and kill him there, then sit at the north-east corner of the camp (loc -733, 1001) staring to north-east waiting for the courier to run to the camp. At (loc -733, 1001) is basically NE corner of the camp almost at the zone wall, sit and he should aggro you. Guard a pet and you will see the pet turn he is near and have "/pet attack a dark elf courier" macro or command being spammed and the pet will get him when in range and before he reaches the camp.
If you can't catch him before he makes it inside (he will set up shop in the western tent) you still have a minute or two to harmony the dark elves and pull courier out but he'll poof fast so you should have harmony loaded up and ready as a backup plan.<br/>

'''Again''': he will despawn in a couple minutes after reaching the camp so act fast!<br/>


Green 2025 Reiterating that he will despawn fast.  So yes, pull Larik there.  



Best Strat if helping another player that is not in your group but on the way to loot.


Pull Larik to loc -733, 1001, the DE camp NE corner of the camp and kill there.  At loc -733, 1001. lmost against the zone wall (NE corner of DE camp), the courier should arrive at that point (just before the DE camp) prior to Larik's corpse opens up for looting.  Yes within 1min 30sec or so of Lariks death.  Guarding a pet there your pet will turn towards the courier when it gets near and you can go ahead and perform the command or make a macro /pet attack a dark elf courier and spam it if the pet turns to face anything.


So it is best to just kill Larik and within less than 1min 30sec expect the courier to be crossing your face there at the DE camp and kill it too.  
Loot both.
